entries.title: Psalms 82:1
segments: A Psalm of Asaph. God stands in the congregation of God; in the midst of the gods He judges.

entries.title: Psalms 82:2
segments: How long will you judge unjustly and lift up the faces of the wicked? Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 82:3
segments: Defend the poor and fatherless; do justice to the afflicted and needy.

entries.title: Psalms 82:4
segments: Deliver the poor and needy; save [them] out of the hand of the wicked.

entries.title: Psalms 82:5
segments: They neither know nor will understand; they walk on in darkness; all the foundations of the earth are shaken.

entries.title: Psalms 82:6
segments: I have said, You [are] gods; and all of you sons of the Most High.

entries.title: Psalms 82:7
segments: But you shall die like men, and fall like one of the princes.

entries.title: Psalms 82:8
segments: Arise, O God, judge the earth; for You shall inherit in all nations.
